method: Exposures found with IRSA MOST (catalog spherex); native strips range-read from the public nasa-irsa-spherex S3 bucket; reprojected onto one north-up 89 x 89 px, 6.15″/px TAN grid; JPL Horizons astrometric positions for observer SPHEREx (-163182) at each exposure mid-time.
